title: RossFast admissibility envelope and near-saturation hydraulic closure research policy
purpose: Permit RossFast to target a qualified subset of SWAP5 physics and hydraulic regimes instead of requiring universal feature coverage, while investigating near-saturation conductivity closures without silently changing physical semantics.
architectural_rules: RossFast is a candidate SoilWaterSolver behind the common SWAP5 soil-water interface; it is not a separate SWAP kernel.
A RossFast production path, if ever admitted, may support only explicitly qualified combinations of hydraulic model, active physics, boundary contracts and state regime.

Unsupported or unqualified combinations must fail closed to an explicitly selected alternative such as FullRichards; RossFast must never silently disable, approximate or replace a requested physical option.
Solver admissibility is separate from physical configuration. Numerical policy may select a solver only after the requested physics are known.

State-dependent admissibility is allowed only when the regime test is explicit, deterministic, diagnostically visible and transaction-safe. A failed RossFast trial must not mutate committed state before fallback.
Mass conservation remains a hard invariant in every admitted, rejected, retry and fallback path.
Qualification against FullRichards must compare identical physical constitutive laws. A solver-specific conductivity law is not an acceptable reference comparison.

admissibility_contract_shape.required_diagnostic: reason_code plus the exact qualification envelope identifier used for the decision
admissibility_contract_shape.runtime_rule: No implicit physics downgrade is permitted to turn NOT_SUPPORTED or NOT_YET_QUALIFIED into ADMISSIBLE.

supported_by_existing_evidence: non-iterative continuity algebra under the synthetic linear face law
same-factorization response-tangent algebra under the synthetic linear bottom-face law
homogeneous unsaturated Ross2011 steady-face table qualification for a bounded head envelope
catalog-level unimodal MvG representation refinement work with source-bound SWAP constitutive functions
explicitly_not_yet_admitted: h greater than the current unsaturated table envelope near full saturation
saturation crossing and saturated storage switching
history-dependent hydraulic options unless separately represented and qualified
full timestep accuracy with sinks and sources
production response tangents for real hydraulic faces
current_qualification_envelope_not_a_pro.interpretation: Items in not_yet_admitted are not automatically permanent exclusions. Each requires a separate qualification gate or an explicit NOT_SUPPORTED decision.

class_A_exact_source_bound_SWAPP_431_KSA.meaning: Use the exact SWAP 4.3.1 KSATEXM constitutive law as physics and improve only its bounded Ross table/coordinate representation.
class_A_exact_source_bound_SWAPP_431_KSA.reference_rule: The qualification oracle must implement the exact source-bound piecewise conductivity law, including the h=-2 cm seam semantics.

class_B_explicit_smooth_near_saturation_.meaning: Investigate a new constitutive conductivity closure that joins the unsaturated law smoothly to the chosen saturated conductivity over an explicit near-saturation interval.
class_B_explicit_smooth_near_saturation_.reference_rule: The identical new closure must be selectable by FullRichards and RossFast before any RossFast-versus-reference accuracy claim is made.
minimum_candidate_properties: K(h) positive over the admitted domain
monotone non-decreasing conductivity toward saturation unless a separately justified hydraulic model states otherwise
C0 continuity at every constitutive join
explicitly tested C1 continuity when a smooth derivative is claimed
no hidden change to retention theta(h) unless the hydraulic model variant explicitly includes it
well-defined matric-flux-potential integral over the complete admitted interval
finite and stable steady-Darcian face response across the join
class_B_explicit_smooth_near_saturation_.preferred_research_property: A closure whose K(h) and MFP behavior are smooth enough to permit compact bounded face-response representation without introducing runtime nonlinear iteration.

qualification_questions: Which SWAP hydraulic option combinations preserve a single-valued, compact and accurately precomputable steady-Darcian face response?
Which options fundamentally add history or auxiliary state that would require a separate Ross table family or make RossFast unattractive?
Can exact KSATEXM be represented within the existing bounded table-memory and O(1) lookup targets, or does it require a different coordinate/partition strategy?
Does a scientifically defensible smooth near-saturation conductivity variant materially improve Ross table conditioning and saturation-transition behavior?
If such a variant is useful, does FullRichards with the same variant remain a stable and accurate reference implementation?
Can solver selection and fallback remain deterministic, transaction-safe and mass-conservative across admissibility boundaries?
research_sequence: Complete or fail-close the existing exact-source-bound KSATEXM C2A line without relaxing its frozen criteria after observing results.
Build an explicit admissibility matrix from SWAP5 physical feature contracts; mark each combination ADMISSIBLE, NOT_YET_QUALIFIED or NOT_SUPPORTED with evidence lineage.
Only after exact KSATEXM evidence is preserved, define one or more class-B smooth near-saturation closure candidates as separate physical hydraulic models.
Characterize class-B candidates first at constitutive level: K, dK/dh where defined, MFP, continuity, monotonicity and endpoint behavior.
Then characterize steady-Darcian face responses across the near-saturation interval with independent offline oracles and frozen holdouts.
Only candidates surviving constitutive and face-response gates may proceed to saturation-transition, timestep, groundwater and FullRichards-equivalence qualification.
hard_no_go_rules: Do not redefine KSATEXM merely to make the current Ross table pass.
Do not call a smooth conductivity modification a numerical approximation if it materially changes the constitutive law; expose it as a physical hydraulic-model variant.
Do not require RossFast to support every SWAP option before it can be useful; require instead a complete explicit admissibility contract for any admitted production use.
Do not promote a restricted RossFast envelope by extrapolation beyond tested heads, materials, boundaries, physics or state regimes.
Do not allow a performance policy to silently select a different physical closure.
exit_condition_for_this_policy_seam: The policy seam is complete when the admissibility matrix is evidence-backed and at least the exact-source-bound near-saturation route has a fail-closed qualification result. A new smooth hydraulic closure remains a separate research candidate until independently qualified in both FullRichards and RossFast.
